capabilities.name: Creation Intake
capabilities.description: Clarifies the human idea, purpose, constraints, and desired outcome.

capabilities.name: Life Impact Review
capabilities.description: Reviews effects on people, animals, ecosystems, and future generations.

capabilities.name: Local Resource Intelligence
capabilities.description: Surfaces local materials, skills, climate, and repair culture without provider APIs.

capabilities.name: Biosphere Protection Layer
capabilities.description: Z-Life Check, habitat, water, soil, waste, and regenerative alternatives.

capabilities.name: 360 Diamond Cube Analysis
capabilities.description: Multidimensional compare across safety, cost, materials, ecology, and stewardship.

capabilities.name: Regeneration / Give-Back Plan
capabilities.description: Consume less than restore — planting, water reuse, habitat buffer, skill share.

capabilities.name: Living Harmony Score
capabilities.description: Advisory discussion signal only — not certification or build approval.

capabilities.name: Conceptual Mini-Bot Registry
capabilities.description: Named review lenses (IntakeBot, SiteBot, MaterialBot, etc.) — no autonomous execution.

biosphere_laws: Avoid animal-derived materials where alternatives exist.
Prefer regenerative, reclaimed, recycled, low-impact, locally repairable resources.
Do not treat nature as unlimited inventory.
Every creation should include a give-back or regeneration plan.
